Q: Running multiple queries in model in codeigniter A:

I know...old, was looking for something else when I saw something that could be done better. the two select statements are identical except for the where statement. you can use "OR" to combine the two WHERE statements. use "DISTINCT" to avoid duplicate entries. Q: Spring Security oauth2 "authorization request not found" A:

Note for all people whom encounter the same error of the OP, even now in 2026 :
If you are using an SSO like Keycloak on its own domain name and your Spring Boot (3 or 4 or whatever while it is blocking yourself at work) application, you must define on your application side some properties about cookie management :

server.servlet.session.cookie.same-site=none
server.servlet.session.cookie.secure=true

And you should then using https configuration even on local machine, to make authentication flux working well with this setup. You can do that using keystore or ssl bundle.

While you do not make this, you will encounter the error you had because of the client browser block the session cookie from the keycloak authentication server you are using.

Using server.use-forward-headers=true is ok, but using :

server.forward-headers-strategy=native
server.tomcat.remoteip.remote-ip-header=X-Forwarded-For
server.tomcat.remoteip.protocol-header=X-Forwarded-Proto

is something you should do too if using classical servlet webapps with Spring Boot, which is using tomcat as default embedded application server.

Q: Intellij modules not finding generated protobuf classes in a multimodule maven project (but works fine via maven cli) A:

I suffered the similar situation when compiling the Apache ozone, some classes like OzoneManagerProtocolProtos.java was generated in command line and I can see it, but IntelliJ IDEA kept ignoring it even if I clicked Generate Sources And Update Folders.

The reason in my case is that the file is too large (15M java file, oops), and it was skipped by IntelliJ. To address it, in IDE click `Help / Edit Custom Properties`, then add this to change the limit to be 20M.

idea.max.intellisense.filesize=20000

Then restart IDE to apply the change.

Q: Defense against common security threat for Desktop Application A:

Common security threats for desktop applications include malware, code injection, reverse engineering, insecure data storage, privilege escalation, and unauthorized access. Recommended defenses include secure coding practices, encryption, code signing, strong authentication, least-privilege access, and regular security updates.
